purpose: City-specific registry and public parcel-geometry source review. No owner, address, tax, or private property fields were requested or retained.
assessment: The municipality publishes static cadastral plans for Cercado del Callao and announced cadastral polygons/holder reports only for cadastral sectors 06 and 07. WUP label point is not confirmed to lie in those sectors or even on a parcel-covered mainland area; the municipal source is therefore not treated as proven coverage for this locator. Static PDFs are not a feature service. No geometry feature was retained; geometry evidence remains unverified.
